## Problem / Use Case
A clear and concise description of the problem you are facing or the learning workflow need (e.g., *"As a learner, I want to..."*).

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of the feature or behavior you would like to see implemented.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, research references, or domain DAG ideas here.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have checked existing issues/discussions to avoid duplicate feature requests.
- [ ] This proposal aligns with SkillTwin's architecture and `shared/schema.md`.
- [ ] I am willing to help build, test, or provide feedback on this feature.
